title: Align json /rules/M09 of matched comparison 0155 with md M09 (review #714 F-N1)
body:
## Goal
Correct only finding F-N1 of review #714 (NOT-CLEAR): benchmark/baseline/matched-comparison-0155.json /rules/M09 still says unsupported cases or arms are recorded as answer_class unsupported, while md M09 separates (a) an arm unavailable before dispatch (unstarted slot, no answer_class) from (b) a dispatched attempt classed answer_class unsupported, with `unsupported -> finished_incomplete` only as the plan-end derivation. Make the json M09 text carry the md M09 meaning with one targeted Edit. Do not edit the md file or any other json field. Design scope only; no model, reader, evaluator or native run. No session can run LabVIEW. Expected gain: md/json parity on M09, so a narrow re-check can close the matched comparison thread.
## Acceptance
- [ ] json /rules/M09 states (a) unavailable-before-dispatch arm = unstarted slot without answer_class and (b) dispatched attempt with answer_class unsupported, and that `unsupported -> finished_incomplete` is only the plan-end derivation, matching md M09.
- [ ] benchmark/baseline/matched-comparison-0155.md is byte-unchanged (SHA256 15d6be1eec07f74d93b982d9909e08b6fd3085214906adec6a9401b719a60933).
- [ ] No other json pointer changes; O01-O06 stay open; no quality threshold added.
- [ ] Report: the old and new M09 json text, new json SHA256, and a statement that nothing else was edited.
## Verification
python3 -c "import json,hashlib; d=json.load(open('benchmark/baseline/matched-comparison-0155.json')); r=d['rules']; m=r['M09'] if isinstance(r,dict) else [x for x in r if 'M09' in json.dumps(x)][0]; assert 'dispatch' in json.dumps(m); assert hashlib.sha256(open('benchmark/baseline/matched-comparison-0155.md','rb').read()).hexdigest()=='15d6be1eec07f74d93b982d9909e08b6fd3085214906adec6a9401b719a60933'; print('OK')"
## Context
- Review #714 report (exported; check .session/exports/manifest.json) names F-N1 and confirms F-M1, F-M3 resolved and F-M2 resolved everywhere except json M09. Reviewed HEAD 07dc83f0; json SHA256 before this fix 04543bdacb7e356bb1ea46c4256659716b0e023066cab5bf29800d769f6e193b.
- This is fix round 2 of 2 for this contract.
- Do not commit; the parent commits. Do not run evaluator, old builders or the frozen #544 checker.
## Budget
- Reads: the #714 report; md M09 section of benchmark/baseline/matched-comparison-0155.md (Grep for M09); json /rules/M09 via a short python3 extraction.
- No other sources, short command output. Edit by about turn 8, report by about turn 15.
